title: Vanishing continuous functions descend through pro-etale neighbourhoods
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ with the topology of an absolute value extending the $\ell$-adic absolute value [def-weil-l-adic-numbers]. Let $g:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes. Use their small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and write $u_g(V)=V\times_XY$ for base change [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Let $V\to X$ and $U\to Y$ be objects of these sites, let $t:|V|\to\Omega$ be any continuous function, and let $\phi:U\to u_g(V)$ be a morphism over $Y$. Suppose $t\circ|\operatorname{pr}_V\circ\phi|=0$. For every $x\in|U|$ there exist an open subscheme $O\subseteq U$ containing $x$, with inclusion $j:O\hookrightarrow U$ [def-weil-open-immersion], an object $V'\to X$ of $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, a morphism $a:V'\to V$ over $X$, and a morphism $\phi':O\to u_g(V')$ over $Y$, such that $t\circ|a|=0$ and $u_g(a)\circ\phi'=\phi\circ j$. No local finiteness condition on $t$ is required.
